openapi-docs-generator-080414 v0.1.0

- Initial release tailored for backend and platform teams working with REST APIs.
- Provides structured workflow to generate, improve, and validate OpenAPI or Swagger documentation.
- Outputs include actionable artifacts, reusable checklists/workflows, and verification notes.
- Designed for local, hardware-friendly use—favoring scripts, templates, and checklists over cloud or large-model approaches.
- Includes clear triggers and criteria to ensure relevant, practical support for API documentation tasks.
